name: find-anything
description: Find the best good-and-cheap deal on anything across fragmented sites, using your own browser. Install the core, plus a domain pack for what you're buying.

plugins.name: find-anything
plugins.description: The core: researches the category, finds where to look, asks you for a login only when a site needs one, vets, computes true cost of ownership, and delivers a ranked shortlist for anything you want to buy. You approve every seller message.

plugins.name: find-cars
plugins.description: Domain pack for used cars: Carsales, Gumtree and Facebook Marketplace adapters, listing vetting, Victorian costs as data, and 3-year cost of ownership with resale. Works on its own.
